notes.title: Bug reports/Bug fixes
notes.content:
This is the official bug report thread. We're planning on collecting data and releasing a patch later on. Please help us by reporting bugs here, not creating new topics. It's also possible that further troubleshooting'll be required.

Fixed:
- keyboard\gamepad controls has been corrected
- jump animation
- Bug with move a box
- Bug 'teleport'
- Death animation
